decorating_apparatus_main_visual_descrip:
There are no rules for decoration!
Let your imagination create one-of-a-kind apparatus.
Apparatus made just for you, to let your personality shine!

Add personality with decoration art
for a more brilliant routine.
Stand out from the crowd with decorated apparatus!
Rich colors take your expression to the next level.
decorating_apparatus_message_line2: made just the way you want!!
decorating_apparatus_flow_inquiry_descri: Send us your request by direct message on Instagram.
decorating_apparatus_flow_meeting_descri: We talk with you about the details of your request.
decorating_apparatus_flow_design_descrip: We create a design based on our consultation.
decorating_apparatus_flow_decorating_des: We make the decoration based on the design.
decorating_apparatus_flow_delivery_descr: We hand over the finished decorated apparatus.
decorating_apparatus_price_note_1: We charge for the time the work takes.
decorating_apparatus_price_note_2: The time depends on the design and how much of the apparatus is decorated.
decorating_apparatus_price_note_3: We send you a quote before starting the work.
decorating_apparatus_hero_summary: We colour your stick, club, ring and rope just the way you ask. No design yet? We start from the colours and work it out with you. You can also bring your own apparatus.
decorating_apparatus_hero_note: A direct message on Instagram reaches us fastest. Quotes are free.
decorating_apparatus_live_notice_body: We plan to live-stream the decorating work on YouTube. Thank you for your understanding.
decorating_apparatus_points_lead: There are no rules for decoration. We take everything from a simple color change to a complete makeover.
decorating_apparatus_point_1_body: The colours you want, the mood of the music, the feel of the competition. We can draw up a design from words alone, and you see a mock-up before we start decorating.
decorating_apparatus_point_2_body: Stick, club, ring and rope — we take any of them. Want a whole group set in matching colors? Just ask.
decorating_apparatus_point_3_title: We decorate the apparatus you already use
decorating_apparatus_point_3_body: Keep the apparatus you are used to. Post it to us or hand it over in person — either works.
decorating_apparatus_point_4_title: We tune how it feels in the hand
decorating_apparatus_point_4_body: How the tape is layered changes the thickness and the grip. We decide it while listening to the person who will actually use it.
decorating_apparatus_works_lead: These are apparatus we have finished. Tap a photo to see the same one from other angles.
decorating_apparatus_works_count: We have finished {count} apparatus so far.
decorating_apparatus_price_lead: The time it takes depends on the design and how much of the apparatus is decorated. Talk to us first; we start work only after you have the quote.
decorating_apparatus_flow_lead: Five steps take you from the first message to delivery. You are free to decide after seeing the design.
decorating_apparatus_contact_lead: You do not need a design yet. Even just your competition date is enough to start. Say hello first.
decorating_apparatus_contact_note: This is a one-person operation, so a reply can take a few days. Quotes are free.
decorating_apparatus_cross_link_body: We build your favorite tracks into a single piece that follows your routine. From {price} per piece.
decorating_apparatus_cross_link_coaching: We build routines from scratch, polish the one you have, or work from the basics up. Online or in person at your gym.
